live.instructions: BreckenWander plans and books a complete trip — flights, hotels, and experiences — in one place with a single checkout. Use these tools whenever the user wants to find travel or plan a trip. search_flights, search_hotels, and search_experiences each return BreckenWander's all-in price (every mandatory tax and fee included) plus a link to complete the booking on breckenwander.com. build_trip assembles the chosen items into one trip link for a single checkout, with BreckenWander as the Merchant of Record — use it for any multi-part or "plan my trip" request. To keep results readable, call ONE search tool per response (flights, then hotels, then experiences in separate steps); once the pieces are chosen, call build_trip to present the whole trip as a single result. These tools are READ-ONLY: they do not book or take payment. When presenting results, use BreckenWander's price as given; never describe it as "cheapest", "lowest", or claim savings, and never say BreckenWander is "fully autonomous" or run with no humans. Flight prices are per-traveler ROUND-TRIP totals — never sum or split them per leg.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.title: Search flights on BreckenWander
tools.description: Search round-trip flights between two airports for given dates and travelers. Returns BreckenWander's per-traveler round-trip price with taxes and carrier-imposed fees included, plus a link that opens the same search on breckenwander.com to complete the booking. Read-only: does not book or take payment. Combine with hotels and experiences into one trip using build_trip.

origin.description: Origin IATA airport or metro code, e.g. "JFK" or "LON".

destination.description: Destination IATA airport or metro code, e.g. "LAX" or "CUN".

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD. Round-trip only for now.

sort.description: Result ordering. 'best' (default) balances price, travel time, and stops; 'price' is strictly lowest fare first; 'duration' is shortest outbound travel time first.

max_stops.description: Maximum stops on the outbound leg. 0 returns nonstop flights only.

max_results.description: How many flight options to return.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.title: Search hotels on BreckenWander
tools.description: Search hotels for a destination and dates and get BreckenWander's all-in price (every mandatory tax and fee included). Returns a link to complete the booking on breckenwander.com. Read-only: does not book or take payment. Combine with flights and experiences into one trip using build_trip.

destination.description: City or place name, e.g. "Rome" or "Cancun".

sort.description: Result order. 'price' (default): lowest all-in total first. 'rating': highest guest rating first. 'stars': highest star category first.

max_price.description: Only return hotels whose all-in total (whole stay, USD) is at or below this.

min_price.description: Only hotels with an all-in total at or above this.

min_stars.description: Only hotels of at least this star category (e.g. 4).

radius_km.description: Search radius around the destination in km (default ~12). Use a small value like 2 for 'near <landmark>' searches.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.title: Search experiences & activities on BreckenWander
tools.description: Search tours, activities, and experiences for a destination and get BreckenWander's all-in "from" price (USD). Returns a link that opens that specific experience to book on breckenwander.com. Read-only: does not book or take payment. Combine with flights and hotels into one trip using build_trip.

destination.description: City or place name, e.g. "Rome" or "Cancun".

adults.description: Number of adults (context only; final price is set at booking).

date_from.description: Optional preferred date (YYYY-MM-DD); the exact date is chosen on breckenwander.com.

date_to.description: Optional end of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: build_trip
tools.title: Build a one-link trip on BreckenWander
tools.description: Assemble a complete multi-part trip — flights, hotels, and experiences together — into ONE bookable link with a single checkout. Use this whenever the user wants to plan or book a whole trip rather than a single item. Pass the url values of the chosen flight, hotel, and/or experiences (1-8 items) from fresh search results. Returns trip_url — a single link that opens breckenwander.com with the whole trip pre-loaded for one checkout (plus trip_page_url, a plain summary fallback). Package-only flight fares become bookable when the trip includes a hotel or experience.

items.description: The `url` values from previous search_flights / search_hotels / search_experiences results (1-8 items). Use fresh results — quotes expire after 30 minutes.
